name: Art Gallery
description: Everyone draws the same prompt, the teacher previews the gallery, then the drawings reveal one at a time on the projector — the template for any draw-and-share moment. Swap in your own drawing prompt for any topic.

intro.message:
ART GALLERY!

You'll get one prompt and 90 seconds to draw it on your device. Every drawing goes up on the wall — so give it your best 90 seconds.

draw.prompt: Draw your dream invention — something the world needs but nobody has built yet.

check.template: Review the drawings below, then open the gallery. One bad drawing? Hide it from the moderation list — 'Try again' restarts the WHOLE round for everyone.

gallery.message: The gallery is open! As each drawing lands, shout your guess: what does this invention DO? Then the artist gets the last word.

end.message: That's the Art Gallery! Somebody in this room should patent something.
